request.style: English, Male baritone solo with backing choir, acoustic guitar, electric guitar, drums, bass, piano, uplifting and majestic mood, 95 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The young lions roar for their prey
Seeking their food from God alone
When the sun rises in the east
They steal away to lie down in dens

[Verse]
People go out to their work
To their labor until evening comes
But the earth is full of your creatures
Made by wisdom, one by one

[Chorus]
How many are your works, LORD
In wisdom you made them all
The earth is full of your creatures
Great and small, standing tall

[Verse]
There is the sea, vast and wide
Teeming with creatures beyond number
Living things both small and great
Ships move along, that’s the measure

[Chorus]
How many are your works, LORD
In wisdom you made them all
The earth is full of your creatures
Great and small, standing tall

[Bridge]
Leviathan plays in the deep
Which you formed to roam
All of them look to you
To give them food in time

[Chorus]
How many are your works, LORD
In wisdom you made them all
The earth is full of your creatures
Great and small, standing tall

[Outro]
Look to you for food at the proper time
Great are your works, in wisdom made
